text:
alex_sales: hey @jamie_se — FinServCo wants to run a Dedicated POC. They need to test from their side using 3 source IPs and want the option to rotate those IPs daily. Can we support multiple static egress IPs for a POC, and can we issue temporary hosted API keys for smoke tests?

jamie_se: short answer: yes to static IPs for Dedicated POCs (depends on pool config). We can also generate short-lived scoped API keys for quick smoke tests via the Console or API. Recommend Dedicated endpoints for strict allowlisting. :+1:

nina_netops: network notes: Dedicated endpoints can egress via either (a) customer's NAT if they bring in VPC peering / private link, or (b) our managed NAT/EIP set if they can't. To provide static egress from our side we provision cloud EIPs and give those IPs to the customer to allowlist. Daily rotation is doable but operationally heavy — better to provide 3 fixed IPs for the POC window. If they insist on rotation we can front with an outbound proxy that swaps IPs on a schedule (adds ~20-60ms). For quick verification you can run:```bash
curl -s https://ifconfig.io
```to see the current egress IP from the test host.

jamie_se: extra bits — if the customer is ok allowlisting FQDNs we can give hostnames (sni-based). mTLS client certs are supported for Private/VPC installs and can be added for Dedicated in some setups (needs infra change).

sam_security: security checklist: POC hosted keys should be scoped and short-lived; do NOT enable log export or KMS access for temporary keys. For Dedicated POCs we can grant limited audit log views and optionally read-only access to usage dashboards. Also need to answer SQQ section 4.2 about IP rotation windows and key revocation process. If they require HSM-backed keys, that's only for Private deployments. :lock:

alex_sales: customer also asked about pricing for extra reserved EIPs during the POC. Can we provide a simple ad-hoc quote?

jamie_se: i'll get pricing — propose including up to 3 EIPs for a 2-week POC at no extra charge, additional EIPs billed at short-term rate. i'll confirm numbers with pricing ops and post here.

nina_netops: created infra ticket INFRA-8921 to provision 3 EIPs in us-west-2 for a test Dedicated pool. Need customer allowlist (IPs/domains), contact for connectivity test, and preferred rotation policy. INFRA-8921 assigned to @nina_netops.

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: dedicated-poc-pool v1.3 deployed to test cluster (us-west-2) at 2025-11-05T12:03:00Z — smoke endpoint available at https://test-dedicated.redwood.ai/health :white_check_mark:

alex_sales: thanks team — i'll loop the customer with next steps: 1) send allowlist (or confirm they accept FQDNs), 2) confirm whether they want fixed 3 IPs or rotating IPs, 3) supply contact for live connectivity testing, and 4) confirm whether they need scoped hosted keys for smoke tests. cc @sam_security for SQQ follow-up.
